name: parse_align
comment:
"""
        Helper function; returns align option from cell content.

        Returns:
            None if align = left;
            0    if align = center;
            1    if align = right.
        """

repo.env_config:
[project]
requires-python = ">=3.10,<4.0"
name = "myproject"
version = "0.1.0"

[tool.poetry]
package-mode = false

[tool.poetry.dependencies]
icontract = "^2.7.1"

[tool.poetry.group.dev.dependencies]
pytest = "^8.4.2"
pytest-cov = "^7.0.0"
pytest-reportlog = "^0.4.0"
pytest-env = "^1.2.0"
parameterized = "^0.9.0"

ref_postcond:
@icontract.ensure(lambda result: result in (None, 0, 1))
@icontract.ensure(lambda result, column: (column.endswith(':') and column.startswith(':') and result == 0) or (column.endswith(':') and not column.startswith(':') and result == 1) or (not column.endswith(':') and result is None))
